start: Chrome on the desk phone, app.mettleup.fit signed in, internet on

steps.action: Open app.mettleup.fit and tap Install app in Chrome's menu
user_sees: Chrome's Install app sheet with the MettleUp admin icon
must_not: No install offer (the service worker did not take the page)

steps.action: Open the installed app once with internet
user_sees: The admin app opens on the newest version
must_not: An old version shown while the newest is online

steps.action: Turn internet off and open the installed app again

A blank white screen
Old buttons from a previous deploy that no longer work

Another gym's alert

steps.action: Tap the notice
user_sees: The admin app opens on that alert's page; an open tab is reused

A page outside the admin app

user_sees: A test notice on this device

The test reaching another device
